# cpanel_gpg_public_key (Data Source)

Looks up one public OpenPGP key stored by cPanel. The data source exports only public material and reports whether matching secret metadata exists; it never reads or exports a private key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_gpg_public_key" "example" {
  id = "0123456789ABCDEF"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The uppercase 16-character cPanel GPG public-key identifier.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) The public-key algorithm text reported by cPanel.
- `bits` (Number) The primary public-key length in bits.
- `content_sha256` (String) The lowercase SHA-256 of the canonical set of decoded public packets.
- `created` (Number) The key creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `expires` (Number) The key expiration time as a Unix timestamp, or null when the key does not expire.
- `fingerprint` (String) The full uppercase 40-character v4 primary-key fingerprint.
- `has_secret_key` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports a matching secret key. No secret key material is read.
- `public_key` (String) The ASCII-armored `PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK`.
- `user_id` (String) The primary user identity reported by cPanel.
